svg.title: Fragmentomics detailed pipeline
svg.desc: cfDNA fragmentomics pipeline. Streck and EDTA FASTQ inputs go through alignment and preprocessing. After BAM, EDTA branches into EDTA and EDTA-HQ via HQ filtering. Three cohorts feed two analyses: fragment length and end motifs. Each analysis compares healthy versus cancer. Integrated results feed biological interpretation.

g.text: Two analyses applied to every cohort, Healthy vs Cancer at each step
cross-cohort consistency: Streck vs EDTA vs EDTA-HQ
